allowlistRules: Only compiler-synthesized accessors or async machinery without stable source mapping may be excluded.
Generated sources may be excluded only when their generator and generated marker are versioned.
Structurally non-executable declarations may be excluded with a written source-level reason.
UI views, adapters, error paths, concurrency code, and difficult asynchronous code are never excluded merely because they are hard to test.
Every exclusion requires an owner, exact source path or mapping identity, reason, approval reference, and review date.
